parts.text: Aventuras de Sherlock Holmes VIII\. — La banda de lunares {{#abril_83 e:holmes q:abril_83|Fue a principios de abril del año 83 cuando una mañana, al despertar, encontré a [[holmes|Sherlock Holmes]] de pie junto a mi cama, completamente vestido.}} Por regla general se levantaba tarde, y el reloj de la repisa marcaba apenas las siete y cuarto, de modo que lo miré parpadeando, con alguna sorpresa y quizá con un poco de resentimiento, pues yo era hombre de costumbres regulares. —Siento mucho despertarlo, Watson —dijo—, pero esta mañana es la suerte de todos. {{#hudson a:inc03 e:holmes q:hudson|A [[mrs_hudson|Mrs. Hudson]] la despertaron, ella se desquitó conmigo, y yo con usted.}} —¿Qué es, entonces? ¿Un incendio? {{#cliente e:holmes q:cliente|—No; una cliente: parece que ha llegado una señorita muy alterada, que insiste en verme.}} {{#velada q:velada|Una dama vestida de negro y cubierta por un espeso velo, que estaba sentada junto a la ventana, se levantó cuando entramos.}} {{#temblar e:helen_stoner q:temblar|—No es el frío lo que me hace temblar —dijo la mujer en voz baja, cambiando de asiento como se le pedía.}} {{#terror e:helen_stoner q:terror|—Es miedo, señor Holmes; es terror.}}

src_en.abril_83: It was early in April in the year ’83 that I woke one morning to find Sherlock Holmes standing, fully dressed, by the side of my bed.
src_en.hudson: Mrs. Hudson has been knocked up, she retorted upon me, and I on you.
src_en.cliente: No; a client. It seems that a young lady has arrived in a considerable state of excitement, who insists upon seeing me.
src_en.velada: A lady dressed in black and heavily veiled, who had been sitting in the window, rose as we entered.
src_en.temblar: It is not cold which makes me shiver,” said the woman in a low voice, changing her seat as requested.
src_en.terror: It is fear, Mr. Holmes. It is terror.
src_en.enorme: our door had been suddenly dashed open, and that a huge man had framed himself in the aperture.
src_en.ave_de_presa: his deep-set, bile-shot eyes, and his high, thin, fleshless nose, gave him somewhat the resemblance to a fierce old bird of prey.
src_en.stoke_moran: I am Dr. Grimesby Roylott, of Stoke Moran.
src_en.azafranes: But I have heard that the crocuses promise well,” continued my companion imperturbably.
src_en.me_rastreo: I know that Miss Stoner has been here.
src_en.atizador: He stepped swiftly forward, seized the poker, and bent it into a curve with his huge brown hands.
src_en.enderezo: As he spoke he picked up the steel poker and, with a sudden effort, straightened it out again.
